comment: АСТУР timer engine config (epic PRO-338, phase 3; Ф3.4/Ф3.6). Loaded by app.config.load_astur_timer_config. lability_item_limit_ms=20000 (bumped from the original 5000 in v5, 2026-09-18): the 5s default turned out too short in practice — live in-office testing showed 5s isn't enough to even read a command before answering, let alone respond, which defeats the point of a lability/speed subtest (it was measuring reading speed, not switching speed). 20s keeps it a timed task without being unreadable. Still a working default, not a psychologist-calibrated value. subtest_time_limit_sec (added Ф3.6): the spec only says subtests 1-2/4-7 have 'таймер на весь субтест' with NO exact per-subtest minute value anywhere in the ticket text — the server was already measuring elapsed time for record-keeping (subtest_timer.py) but nothing defined a value for the frontend's own 'переход ... по истечении таймера субтеста' requirement (Ф3.6) to count down against. Values below are working defaults (rough per-item pacing for a group-administered intelligence test: ~15-20s/item for MC/classification/numeric formats, ~30s/item for open-text generalization and drag-and-drop schemas), same draft/pending-calibration status as everything else in this file — NOT enforced server-side as a hard cutoff (Ф3.4's 'never lose progress' principle: a late submit is still accepted, this is a UI nudge only). geometric_figures (added v4, Ф3.1): same ~20-25s/item MC-like pacing as classification/numeric, 5 items -> ~2 min. lability has no entry here — it uses lability_item_limit_ms per-command instead, not a whole-subtest budget. Changing any value = edit here + bump `version`, no code change.
